pcs_sets.note: total hysterectomy (uterus + cervix) with open bladder fistula repair

rationale: Two objectives: hysterectomy = Resection of uterus (and cervix when total) plus fistula closure = Repair of bladder, open.
Exstrophy closure restores bladder anatomy without a device: Repair of bladder, open; bladder neck repair added when reconstructed as a distinct part.

pcs_sets.note: ileal patch (ileocystoplasty) with ileal segment harvest
sigmoid patch with sigmoid segment harvest

rationale: Bowel patch reinforces/enlarges the bladder = Supplement of bladder with autologous tissue; bowel harvest coded separately per B3.9.
Vesicostomy diverts urine from bladder to skin = Bypass bladder to cutaneous, open, no device.

pcs_sets.note: excision of strictured/scarred segment with primary anastomosis
graft substitution with buccal mucosa harvest

rationale: One-stage posterior urethroplasty is usually scar excision with anastomosis = Excision of urethra, open; graft augmentation is Supplement plus donor-site excision.

pcs_sets.note: bladder neck cuff (Removal has no bladder-neck value, codes to bladder)

rationale: Remove infected artificial sphincter and place a new one: Removal plus Insertion of artificial sphincter, urethra (or bladder neck), open.
Endarterectomy removes plaque = Extirpation; deep femoral is a femoral artery branch so body part is femoral artery, open.

Return to neck after vascular surgery, most often for bleeding = Control bleeding in neck region (B3.7); clot or infection findings code to Extirpation or Drainage; negative exploration is Inspection.

pcs_sets.note: portal to hepatic vein, covered stent

rationale: TIPS creates a percutaneous portal-to-hepatic vein shunt = Bypass portal vein to hepatic vein with synthetic substitute (FY2027 qualifier 4).
Ligation closes the artery lumen = Occlusion, open, no device; body part depends on which abdominal artery is tied.

Tumor replaces the carotid body and is removed whole = Resection of carotid body, open (Excision 0GB if only part removed); carotid body dx sits in MDC 1 and the procedure does not, so it groups 981-983 by v44 logic.

pcs_sets.note: right, internal carotid segment replaced by graft
left, internal carotid segment replaced by graft

rationale: Carotid body Resection plus a distinct arterial objective: Excision of the carotid segment, or Replacement when an interposition graft takes its place.
